snippet.title: "Kinki Spiritual Affairs Bureau" Playstation™5 ＆ XBOX Series X|S version Trailer
snippet.description:
"Kinki Spiritual Affairs Bureau" is a Japanese-style horror TPS game where you can fight back against the spirits. 
Developed by indie game developer "Noto Muteki," the Steam version was released in October 2024. The game's unique concept of being a "horror game where you can fight back against unreasonable spirits that are immune to bullets and fists," typical in Japanese horror, has captivated many players. 
To enable more people to enjoy this title, AMATA Games will take on the porting and distribution of the PlayStation™5 and XBOX Series X|S versions.

PlayStation™Store:
 https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014681/
Microsoft Store(XBOX):
 https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9nd5hjr0xttf
